def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format Unix seconds ts as HH:MM:SS in UTC, 24-hour, zero padded.
    Negative timestamps count back from the epoch, so the time of day wraps modulo 86400."""
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    ex stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(-1) == "23:59:59"
    s = (ts % 86400 + 86400) % 86400
    h = s // 3600
    m = (s % 3600) // 60
    sec = s % 60
    hs = str(h) if h >= 10 else "0" + str(h)
    ms = str(m) if m >= 10 else "0" + str(m)
    ss = str(sec) if sec >= 10 else "0" + str(sec)
    return hs + ":" + ms + ":" + ss
